content.text: 先按冷启动读记忆包，再对照这个 VSIX 把 dc-platform 插件升到 0.0.136。
记忆里有一条红线：插件版本不自改、不自打 vsix。你这次给的是官方包 `0.0.136`，我先核对安装方式和当前版本，再按这个包更新。

input.command: ls -lh /Users/mac/Downloads/dc-platform-0.0.136.vsix; echo "---"; which cursor code 2>/dev/null; echo "--- cursor cli ---"; cursor --list-extensions --show-versions 2>/dev/null | rg -i "dc-platform|dc_platform" || true; echo "--- code cli ---"; code --list-extensions --show-versions 2>/dev/null | rg -i "dc-platform|dc_platform" || true
input.description: Check vsix and installed dc extension

input.command: cursor --list-extensions --show-versions 2>&1 | head -200; echo "==== EXT DIRS ===="; ls -d ~/.cursor/extensions/*dc* ~/.vscode/extensions/*dc* 2>/dev/null; echo "==== FIND ===="; find ~/.cursor/extensions ~/.vscode/extensions -maxdepth 2 -iname '*dc-platform*' -o -iname '*dcplatform*' 2>/dev/null | head -50

ls -d /Applications/Cursor.app/Contents/Resources/app/bin/cursor 2>/dev/null; ls /usr/local/bin/cursor /opt/homebrew/bin/cursor 2>/dev/null; echo "--- which ---"; type -a cursor; echo "--- extensions.json snippet ---"; python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os
p=os.path.expanduser("~/.cursor/extensions/extensions.json")
print("exists", os.path.exists(p), p)
if os.path.exists(p):
    data=json.load(open(p))
    items=data if isinstance(data, list) else data.get("extensions") or data
    for e in items:
        ident=e.get("identifier") or {}
        mid=ident.get("id") or e.get("id") or ""
        if "dc" in mid.lower() or "platform" in mid.lower():
            print(mid, e.get("version"), e.get("relativeLocation") or e.get("location"))
PY
echo "--- vsix package.json ---"
unzip -p /Users/mac/Downloads/dc-platform-0.0.136.vsix extension/package.json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; p=json.load(sys.stdin); print(p.get("publisher"), p.get("name"), p.get("version"), p.get("displayName"))'

content.text: 当前已装的是 `0.0.133`，包内确认是官方 `dc-platform` `0.0.136`。开始安装。

input.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os
p=os.path.expanduser("~/.cursor/extensions/extensions.json")
data=json.load(open(p))
items=data if isinstance(data, list) else data.get("extensions") or data
for e in items:
    ident=e.get("identifier") or {}
    mid=ident.get("id") or e.get("id") or ""
    if "dc-platform" in mid.lower():
        print("id:", mid)
        print("version:", e.get("version"))
        print("location:", e.get("relativeLocation") or e.get("location"))
PY
echo "--- dir ---"
ls -d ~/.cursor/extensions/dc-platform.dc-platform-* 
echo "--- package ---"
python3 -c 'import json; p=json.load(open(os.path.expanduser("~/.cursor/extensions/dc-platform.dc-platform-0.0.136/package.json"))); print(p["publisher"], p["name"], p["version"])' 2>/dev/null || python3 - <<'PY'
import os, json
base=os.path.expanduser("~/.cursor/extensions")
for name in os.listdir(base):
    if name.startswith("dc-platform.dc-platform-0.0.136"):
        pj=os.path.join(base, name, "package.json")
        p=json.load(open(pj))
        print(name, p.get("publisher"), p.get("name"), p.get("version"))
PY
